title: Auditable Context-Aware HFMD Forecasting with Structured LLM Agents

claim.summary: A two-agent HFMD system converts contextual evidence into a bounded transmission-impact signal and produces one-week-ahead count forecasts with deterministic distributional calibration.

modules.name: HFMD event-impact interpretation
modules.scope_reason: School, climate and surveillance evidence are interpreted using a disease-specific transmission hierarchy and one-week effect lag.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "Agent 1 returns four fields"

modules.name: Context-conditioned count forecasting and calibration
modules.scope_reason: Forecast generation and count-distribution moment matching are tied to incidence forecasting.
evidence_locators: PDF p.7; passage beginning "Agent 2 receives the full"
